hero.name: Sorawit Siamhong
hero.title: Full Stack Developer
hero.description: “I have experience in developing web applications, POS systems, and government platforms. My goal was to create a reliable and efficient system. Solve complex problems and improve performance Working together effectively as a team.”

responsibilities.1: Manage and develop POS related systems
responsibilities.2: Design and develop various systems such as E-Tax (full tax invoice), inventory management, stock adjustment, product management, data interface in the system with outsiders, reporting
responsibilities.3: Consult with team members to resolve issues. Inside the team or outside
responsibilities.4: Develop the system and make recommendations to improve the efficiency of the system and team
responsibilities.5: Create a backend system connected to MQ (Message Queue)
responsibilities.6: Fix system issues quickly to reduce downtime
responsibilities.7: Doing test cases before deploying to ensure the quality of the work
responsibilities.8: Study and find new tools, Tool, AI, to develop yourself and your team.

responsibilities.1: Design, develop, and maintain websites, applications, and other systems according to client requirements.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
